title: GtmEntityFieldsResponse
description: Response model containing a collection of GTM entity field definitions.

data.description: The primary data of the document

id.description: The unique identifier for the resource

GtmEntityField.description: Represents a field definition within a GTM entity, containing metadata about the field's characteristics and constraints.

name.description: The unique identifier name of the field

displayName.description: The human-readable name of the field

dataType.description: The data type of the field

required.description: Indicates whether this field is required

fieldType.description: The classification type of the field

description.description: A description explaining the purpose of this field

pickListValues.description: Available predefined values for fields with limited options

reference.description: Reference to another entity or field

GtmEntityFieldAttributes.description: Attributes that define the characteristics and metadata of a field within a GTM entity.
